high_level_description: This image depicts the exterior of a medical facility, specifically Zone IX in Chennai, as indicated by the signboard at the top. The signboard lists various medical tests available, categorized into four sections: Haematology, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology, and Clinical Pathology. Each section includes specific tests such as Total Count (TC), Blood Sugar, Blood Urea, and HIV testing. Below the signboard is a mural painted on the wall. The mural features an angelic figure with wings, dressed in blue medical scrubs and a stethoscope around his neck.
